title: Chapter 277 The Mysterious White Chariot
content:
Chapter 277 The Mysterious White Chariot

“Boom boom boom…!”

The second round of attack by the Zerg destroyers was faster than the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the alien army.

This shows that the firing rate of the giant catapults and giant energy cannons is much slower than that of the Zerg destroyers.

Through the perspective of the Zerg host, Wu Qing can see the giant catapults and giant energy cannons in the 996 cities of the aliens that are being loaded and inspected.

To be honest, I have been using Yeguo Reading to read books and follow the updates recently. It switches sources and has many reading tones. It is available on Android and Apple.

“Boom boom boom…!”

It was another contest between the Zerg destroyers’ attack and the interception of the anti-aircraft firepower network of the alien army.

The Zerg destroyers’ attack, which broke through layers of interception, still could not break the light attribute energy shields on the launch positions of the ultra-long-range siege equipment.

“Bang bang bang…!”

At the beginning of the third round of attack by the Zerg destroyers, the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the aliens finally launched a second attack.

The alien army attacked those super-long-range siege equipment that could reach the main battle formation of the Zerg army. All the super-long-range siege equipment that could not reach the main battle formation of the Zerg army stopped attacking.

This resulted in the number of shells flying towards the Zerg army being reduced by more than half.

The range of the Zerg destroyer is farther than that of the alien army's super-long-range siege equipment, but at the current position, it can only attack a small part of the 996 city of the aliens.

In order to attack the entire 996 city of the aliens, the launch position of the Zerg destroyer needs to be moved forward.

In the early stage of the war, the Zerg army did not need to advance rashly. It was enough for the Zerg destroyer to attack a part of the 996 city.

The Zerg puppies with sufficient manpower only besieged the city and did not attack it.

The army of the 996 city of the aliens also defended the city and did not send troops out of the city to attack.

Both the Zerg and the aliens were well prepared. Whoever launched a strong attack rashly would suffer.

The two sides used ultra-long-range attack arms and siege equipment to bombard each other, consuming each other's ultra-long-range attack power and anti-aircraft firepower.

In this competition, the aliens were obviously at a disadvantage.

The strength of the main combat arms of the Zerg was not weak. They were affected by the explosion of the ultra-long-range siege equipment shells of the intercepted alien army. At most, they were injured. With the defense and self-healing ability of the Zerg, it would not take long to recover.

The losses of the 996 city of the aliens were much greater. Under the full-scale attack of the Zerg destroyers, a large number of buildings in the city were damaged and a large number of people were killed and wounded.

Wu Qing could see the losses of the aliens from the rapidly increasing resources of the system.

The aliens have evacuated all non-combatants in the attacked area of 996 city to other urban areas to reduce casualties.

The military quality and equipment of these non-combatants of the alien race are actually good. If they are placed in ordinary arms, they can also be rated as medium-level.

When necessary, these non-combatants, like the puppies of the Zerg, are excellent consuming troops.

This war, which seems to be even more grand in scale, fell into a stalemate as soon as it started.

Wu Qing originally planned to fight a protracted war. If the alien race is willing to stalemate like this, he has no objection.

The five-star Zerg destroyer attacked the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the alien race for several rounds, but still failed to break the light attribute energy shields guarding the launch position.

Wu Qing gave up the plan to use the five-star Zerg destroyer to knock out the ultra-long-range attack capability of the alien race, and instead let 10,000 five-star Zerg destroyers attack the air defense arms of the alien army distributed throughout the city.

The attack power of the five-star Zerg destroyer is very strong, causing large-scale casualties in the air defense arms of the alien army.

The reduction of the anti-aircraft forces in the alien army affected the anti-aircraft firepower network of the alien city of Jiujiuli, allowing more Zerg destroyers' attacks to fall into the city.

More Zerg destroyers' attacks broke through the anti-aircraft firepower network of Jiujiuli City, and more anti-aircraft forces in the alien army could be killed.

This is a vicious cycle. Unless the alien army continues to send additional anti-aircraft forces to the attacked area, the Zerg destroyers will slowly consume most of the anti-aircraft forces of the alien army participating in the war.

And then completely destroy the urban area of the attacked alien city of Jiujiuli.

Of course, this requires a process. Now the anti-aircraft firepower of the alien army is still very strong and it takes time to consume it.

As time goes by, tens of millions of Zerg and alien troops participate in the war. The only ones who really participate in the battle are the ultra-long-range attack forces and siege weapons of both sides, plus the anti-aircraft forces of both sides.

"The Zerg has deployed so many troops this time, why don't they attack the city in one go?"

"The aliens are also quite strange. They still suffer losses in such a consumption competition with the Zerg!"

"After two battles, the Zerg and the aliens are very familiar with each other, and they have some understanding of each other's various methods. It is more difficult to win by surprise, so they can only compete in consumption!"

"Whoever launches a full-scale attack first will fall into a passive position. It is impossible to defeat the opponent quickly. It will only increase casualties. It is better to just waste time!"

"Especially the aliens, going out of the city to counterattack the Zerg army is very disadvantageous to them. Now they are competing in consumption, and their losses are actually not that big!"

"It is relatively cost-effective to use some troops to consume the offensive firepower of the Zerg army. Facts have proved that the number of attacks of the Zerg's ultra-long-range attack arms is also limited!"

"Perhaps the Zerg still wants to continue to attract more alien troops this time!"

"As long as the Zerg is not in a hurry to attack the city, the Zerg will take the initiative. Now it depends on how the aliens respond!"

"..."

This time, more observers from various forces in the local camp came to watch the battle. They also have a deeper understanding of the Zerg. Through the actions of the Zerg army, they can guess some of Wu Qing's thoughts.

Attracting more alien troops to come for a decisive battle is an open conspiracy, and the aliens know it better than anyone else.

But there are many reasons for the aliens, which lead them to also want to fight a decisive battle with the Zerg. They are now choosing to consume like this, and they must have their own ideas.

In a large-scale decisive battle, the overall strength and foundation of the two tribes will be fought to the end.

…

The war between the Zerg and the alien race fell into a stalemate, and Wu Qing went to the desert battlefield of the Naga tribe.

After accumulating enough troops, the desert race outside the Naga desert main city launched a larger-scale siege again.

But they did not expect that the large number of poisonous ray scorpions lurking underground did not cooperate with their attack as planned.

This led to the desert race using a huge force to barely break through the fire blockade of more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers, and finally gained nothing.

With their disabled bodies, they were no match for the Naga army.

This siege of the desert race ended in failure again.

After this battle, the fact that the poisonous ray scorpions were disobedient has been exposed, and the Zerg host has cut off the connection between the poisonous ray scorpions and the scorpion king behind them.

With such a large-scale loss of contact with the poisonous ray scorpions, the scorpion king would only think that the poisonous ray scorpions on the front line had encountered something wrong, and would not think that someone had taken control.

There is almost no record of the control of the insect king being taken away by the group of insects, so the Scorpion King would not think about it.

The Naga tribe found that the fire blockade of the Zerg destroyers was a bit difficult, so they provided the Zerg destroyers with a batch of luck beads and energy coins.

Wu Qing did not choose to increase the number of five-star Zerg destroyers this time, but upgraded the strength of some one-star Zerg destroyers to two stars.

After such an upgrade, the overall combat power of the Zerg destroyers has been greatly improved.

The desert race has entered the stage of accumulating troops again, and should also be secretly looking for an effective way to attack the city. For the time being, there is no strength to launch an attack again.

The desert battlefield of the Naga tribe has also fallen into peace again.

...

Wu Qing returned to the battlefield of the Jiujiu City of the Tianwai people.

After this period of high-intensity attrition war, the ultra-long-range siege equipment of the Tianwai people has basically stopped attacking. They seem to have suffered some losses in high-intensity combat and need maintenance.

The attack frequency of the Zerg destroyers also dropped. They entered a rotation attack mode, attacking once and then resting for a while, taking turns to attack and rest and recover.

In the attacked urban area of the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City, most of the air defense troops were lost, and other troops almost all hid in various bunkers to reduce casualties.

Wu Qing came over and immediately upgraded the strength of some one-star Zerg destroyers to two-star.

The two-star Zerg destroyers, which were instantly full of status, launched a more fierce attack on the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City.

The area of the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City that was attacked suffered more and more losses, and all the ground buildings were destroyed. The limited air defense troops no longer intercepted the Zerg destroyers' attacks and all hid in specially designed bunkers.

If the fight continues like this, it seems that the Zerg has easily captured a city area of the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City.

The situation is obviously very unfavorable to the Tianwai Human Race.

Suddenly, in the area of the Tianwai Human Race's 996 City that is suspected to be a space transmission channel, a violent fluctuation of magic energy appeared!

The area suspected to be a space transmission channel is outside the attack range of the Zerg destroyer. The Zerg host cannot detect the situation inside. It seems that there is a rule-level power to block the detection and perception of the outside world.

Wu Qing has seen this rule-level shielding power once, but it has a flaw. As long as something is exposed in the shielded area, the Zerg host can immediately detect the situation inside, making the rule-level shielding power invalid.

The ability of the Zerg host is also a rule-level power. This is a contest between rule-level powers.

Wu Qing saw an ancient chariot pulled by a white horse through the Zerg host.
